selection_process: Selection will be made through a 3-stage process:
Screening of applications based on eligibility criteria Written Test - this may be conducted only if the number of applications received exceeds 10 per post Interview
Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the written test/interview process.
how_to_apply: Download the detailed advertisement, application form, and Terms of Reference (ToRs) from the official websites: www.idsp.mohfw.gov.in or www.ncdc.mohfw.gov.in
Read the Terms of Reference carefully and confirm eligibility for the post before applying
Fill out the application form completely, including personal details, educational qualifications, experience, and references
Attach a resume along with the filled application form
Email the resume and application form to [email protected]
Ensure the application reaches before the last date, 29 September 2026
important_instructions: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the written test/interview process No TA/DA (Travel Allowance/Dearness Allowance) will be admissible for attending the written test/interview process Candidates must bring all original certificates, including experience certificates, for verification Candidates without original documents will not be permitted to appear for the written test/interview Posts are purely on a contract basis, with an initial tenure and possibility of extension on a yearly basis

content_sections.heading: NCDC IDSP Recruitment Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a 3-stage process: Screening of applications based on eligibility criteria Written Test - this may be conducted only if the number of applications received exceeds 10 per post Interview Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the written test/interview process.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for NCDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry self-attested copies of the following documents, and originals must be produced for verification at the time of the written test/interview: Degree/Diploma/Certificate Experience Certificate Age Proof (10th Mark sheet) Any other relevant document/certificate Candidates who do not bring original documents will not be permitted to appear for the written test/interview process.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the written test/interview process No TA/DA (Travel Allowance/Dearness Allowance) will be admissible for attending the written test/interview process Candidates must bring all original certificates, including experience certificates, for verification Candidates without original documents will not be permitted to appear for the written test/interview Posts are purely on a contract basis, with an initial tenure and possibility of extension on a yearly basis

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 - Important Links
content_sections.text: Candidates with a background in Public Health or Community Medicine can also explore more Public Health Jobs and Medical Officer Government Jobs available across India. Applicants looking for opportunities in the health sector can also check the latest Ministry of Health & Family Welfare Jobs and Contract-Based Government Jobs. Those searching for positions closer to the National Capital Region can browse more Delhi Government Jobs and New Delhi Government Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NCDC Various Contractual Posts is 29th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies announced for various contractual posts at the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this NCDC recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NCDC recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for these NCDC posts?
faq.answer: The posts announced under this NCDC recruitment are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the NCDC located?
faq.answer: The National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) is located in Delhi, with the specific address being Delhi, 110054.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NCDC recruitment typically involves Screening, followed by a Written Test, and finally an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for NCDC jobs?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for posts located in Delhi. While candidates from any state can apply, they must be willing to relocate to Delhi if selected.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this NCDC recruitment is CBC 17129/11/0008/2627. It is important to refer to this number for any correspondence.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for NCDC recruitment can be found on the organization's official website, www.idsp.mohfw.gov.in. A direct link is usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of job portals.
